title: Grade 3 French — Mon, Jun 09
description: La famille — Day 1 of 5: Core family members
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'family' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La famille' = the family. 'Ma famille est grande.' = My family is big.

questions.question: How do you say 'father' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le père' = father. 'Mon père s'appelle Arjun.' = My father is called Arjun.

questions.question: How do you say 'mother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La mère' = mother. 'Ma mère est médecin.' = My mother is a doctor.

questions.question: How do you say 'brother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le frère' = brother. 'J'ai un frère.' = I have one brother.

questions.question: How do you say 'sister' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La sœur' = sister. 'Ma sœur s'appelle Priya.' = My sister is called Priya.

questions.question: How do you say 'grandfather' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le grand-père' = grandfather. 'Mon grand-père a 70 ans.' = My grandfather is 70.

questions.question: How do you say 'grandmother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La grand-mère' = grandmother. 'Ma grand-mère fait de bons gâteaux.' = My grandmother makes good cakes.

questions.question: What does 'les parents' mean in French?
questions.explanation: 'Les parents' = the parents (mother and father). 'Mes parents sont gentils.' = My parents are kind.

questions.question: How do you say 'children' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Les enfants' = children. 'J'ai deux enfants.' = I have two children. 'Un enfant' = a child.

questions.question: What is 'le fils' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Le fils' = the son. 'C'est le fils de mon voisin.' = He is my neighbour's son.

questions.question: What is 'la fille' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La fille' = the daughter (or girl). Context tells us which meaning is intended.

questions.question: Complete: 'J'ai un ___ et une ___.' = I have one brother and one sister.
questions.explanation: 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' = I have a brother and a sister.

questions.question: What does 'Voici ma famille.' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Voici ma famille.' = Here is my family. 'Voici' = here is/these are — used to introduce or present.

questions.question: How do you say 'my father and my mother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mon père et ma mère' = my father and my mother. Note: 'mon' (masc.) + 'ma' (fem.).

questions.question: Which sentence introduces your family in French?
options: Voici ma famille: mon père, ma mère et ma sœur.
questions.explanation: 'Voici ma famille: mon père, ma mère et ma sœur.' = Here is my family: my father, my mother, and my sister.
